subject: Terranea VPC gateway dry run: scheduling & preflight
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@terranea.com>, Priya Raman <priya.r@terranea.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Terranea VPC gateway dry run: scheduling & preflight

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for moving this forward. As discussed on the onboarding call, we'd like to run a full VPC gateway dry run before the production handover so both teams exercise the peering, private endpoints, and routing policies under an operational cadence. Proposed scope:

- Validate VPC peering and route advertisements (both directions)
- Confirm private endpoints (Redwood control plane & API) reachability from Terranea VPC
- Exercise NAT/firewall rules for egress to monitoring endpoints and software updates
- Run the warm failover scenario for a node restart (KV cache warming check)

I've attached a diagram (terranea_vpc_diagram_v2.pdf) and a short checklist (implementation_checklist.xlsx). Proposed windows:

- Option A: Tue Sep 26, 09:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: Wed Sep 27, 13:00–15:00 PT

Please confirm which works best and share the primary on-call/network contact for Terranea. Also include any internal maintenance windows or IP blocks we should avoid.

Preflight asks (short):
- Temporary BGP session or static routes for the test subnets
- Open outbound to 52.23.0.0/16 for Redwood monitoring/agents
- Confirm CIDR ranges and any overlapping routes we should be aware of

Thanks — will put together a runbook and a recording checklist once we lock the time.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0191

Attachments: terranea_vpc_diagram_v2.pdf, implementation_checklist.xlsx

> Thanks again for moving this forward. As discussed on the onboarding call, we'd like to run a full VPC gateway dry run...

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. We can do a dry run but Option A is tight for our infra team. Can we aim for Option B (Wed Sep 27, 13:00–15:00 PT)? Priya (cc) will coordinate network on our side.

Our quick notes:
- We'll provide a temporary BGP peer for the test subnets; names/ASNs to follow
- We have a maintenance window on Sep 29 evening that you should avoid
- Terranea NAT gateway will permit outbound to the 52.23.0.0/16 range during the test

I'll upload our internal preflight checklist (small PDF) to your shared drive and loop in netops once I have the ASN.

— Alex
Alex Wu
Head of Platform, Terranea Systems
alex.wu@terranea.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Terranea VPC gateway dry run: scheduling & preflight

Thanks for kicking this off, Soojin.

A few internal action items before we lock the date:
- Can you add Monica from CS (monica_patel@redwood.ai) to the scheduled invite — she'll own the post-run customer validation steps and acceptance sign-off.
- We'll want security on the call for the KV warming/telemetry egress check — suggest inviting security@redwood.ai to observe (no action expected unless traffic fails).
- Prepare a short rollback checklist in case route advertisements behave unexpectedly (stop BGP, withdraw routes, verify control-plane access).

Also: please ensure the runbook includes explicit timings for each step (0–15m: baseline connectivity, 15–45m: peering & route validation, 45–75m: private endpoint validation, 75–90m: failover and recovery).

If Alex confirms Wed 27 we can schedule a 90-minute block and reserve the follow-up 30-minute buffer next day for any leftover items.

— Kim
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Customer Success Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@terranea.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Terranea VPC gateway dry run: scheduling & preflight

Confirmed — Wed Sep 27, 13:00–14:30 PT works for Terranea. Our netops lead (Priya) will be primary on the call and netops@terranea.com is on cc.

I've attached the ASN details and our internal checklist to the shared drive. Please note the following IP blocks for the test: 10.201.0.0/16 (app), 10.202.0.0/16 (services). No overlaps with Redwood ranges as of our last inventory.

We expect to provide the BGP peer in the first 10 minutes; if you need static routes for the rehearsal we can stand those up as well.

— Alex

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@terranea.com>, Priya Raman <priya.r@terranea.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Sep 2028 23:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Terranea VPC gateway dry run: scheduling & preflight

Alex / Priya — thanks for confirming. We're all set on our side for Wed Sep 27, 13:00–14:30 PT. Final notes and runbook links below — please review before the call: 

- Pre-connection checklist (do this 24–48h before): confirm ASN & BGP password, upload public key for control-plane agent, add our monitoring IP 52.23.12.9/32 to your allowlist.
- Dry run (90m) agenda (final):
  * 0–15m: baseline ping/traceroutes and control-plane agent registration
  * 15–40m: bring up BGP / advertise test prefixes, validate routes & symmetric path
  * 40–60m: verify private endpoints (API & metrics) from app subnets
  * 60–80m: simulate node restart / KV cache rebuild, observe latency and token-count metrics
  * 80–90m: rollback exercise and sign-off criteria review

- Acceptance: Terranea to confirm reachability to private endpoints and healthchecks green for 10 minutes post-run.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/terranea/vpc-preflight (contains the runbook and our dryrun-instructions.txt)
Jira: JIRA-OPS-9182 (will track action items)

Meeting invite will go out from my calendar in 10 minutes. Meeting link + dial-in included.

See you on Wed — if anything changes ping me on Slack and I'll escalate to on-call infra.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: dryrun-instructions.txt
